title: Open Reel — a vintage tape transport

subject.summary: A generic upright vintage reel-to-reel recorder: two enormous open three-spoke reels, unequal tape packs, a continuous flat tape ribbon threaded past three heads, an engaging pinch roller, twin moving VU needles and deeply stepped chunky knobs. The requested features are user-supplied; dimensions, construction, typography and illustrative motion are inferred design choices, not a particular manufacturer's documented machine. Tape occupies a fixed geometric path while its transport rotates; winding radii stay constant and meter needles are not driven by audio.

sources.title: Public showcase request: vintage reel-to-reel tape recorder
sources.ref: A vintage reel-to-reel tape recorder with two large reels that turn, tape running between them past the heads, VU meters and chunky knobs.

facts.value: Tape running between the reels past the heads

facts.note: Chosen showcase proportions for an upright large-reel deck, including feet; not measured dimensions.

facts.value: Four feet, thick side cheeks, a recessed front plate, a separate lower console and sparse side ventilation
facts.note: Generic vintage cabinet construction selected for a legible silhouette; no brand or model is implied.

facts.value: 0.278 m flanges, three broad swept spokes per flange, stepped locking hubs; reel centres 0.310 m apart
facts.note: Designed from the request; front and rear flanges have genuine open windows, not decorative solid discs.

facts.value: 0.00635 m wide ribbon; supply winding radius 0.102 m, take-up radius 0.075 m
facts.note: A plausible quarter-inch-style tape path and visibly unequal winding packs, chosen rather than measured.

facts.value: Erase, record and playback heads with two outside guide rollers and a capstan/pinch pair
facts.note: Generic three-head interpretation. The request specifies heads, not their count or technical arrangement.

facts.value: Illustrative common tape speed 0.08 m/s: supply 7.48964 rpm; take-up 10.18592 rpm; guides 58.76490 rpm; capstan 95.49297 rpm; pinch -47.74648 rpm
facts.note: Computed as 60v/(2*pi*r), not a claimed recording speed. Fixed pack radii for a short loop; the ribbon is a stationary geometric locus, not a simulated moving tape surface. Both reels turn counterclockwise from the front.

facts.value: The pinch arm turns 18 degrees into operating contact below the capstan
facts.note: Designed mechanism; the one-shot articulation engages the transport. All parts on the arm travel with it.

facts.value: Twin analog arc scales and independently swinging needles
facts.note: The user supplies VU meters, not readings. Needle motion is illustrative and not sound-reactive or measurement data.
